name: Carousel
intent: A track of slides people page through with previous and next buttons, swipe or the arrow keys, like a gallery or featured cards.
usage: Use Carousel for galleries, featured cards and paged media. It is one component: pass items as an array of slides. slidesPerView shows 1 to 4 slides at once, so the next ones peek in. Previous and next are kit Buttons beside the track (above and below it when vertical); they turn off at the ends unless loop wraps around. People can also swipe or scroll the track, and press the arrow keys when it has focus. showIndex adds a Slide 2 of 5 caption under it. See contracts/carousel.json for the full contract.

items.note: One node per slide. Each fills its slide's width (and height when vertical).

orientation.note: Vertical is a 200-tall track paged up and down.

slidesPerView.note: How many slides show at once. The last page stops at the end, so the track never shows empty space.

alignment.note: Where a slide lines up when it is the current one. Center matters when more than one slide shows.

loop.note: Next on the last page goes back to the first, and previous on the first goes to the last. The buttons stay on.

showControls.note: The previous and next buttons. Without them, people swipe, scroll or use the arrow keys.

showIndex.note: A caption under the track, like Slide 2 of 5, counted by page.

onIndexChange.note: (index: number) => void. The current page, counted from 0.

label.note: Names the carousel for screen readers, like Featured reports.

useWhen: Galleries, featured cards and paged media.
A row of cards wider than the space, where peeking at the next one invites people to page.
doNot: Do not add CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious or CarouselNext. Pass items.
Do not use it to switch views. Use Tabs.
Do not use it to page a list or table. Show the rows.
Do not use it for main navigation.
a11y: A region with aria-roledescription carousel, named by label. It takes focus, and the arrow keys page it (up and down when vertical).
Each slide is a group with aria-roledescription slide, named Slide 2 of 5.
Previous and next are kit Buttons named Previous slide and Next slide, with the same Tooltip. They are disabled at the ends unless loop is on.
The index caption is a polite live region, so paging is announced.
Paging scrolls smoothly unless the person prefers reduced motion.
snippet:
<Carousel
  label="Featured reports"
  items={reports.map((r) => <ReportCard key={r.id} {...r} />)}
  slidesPerView={3}
  showIndex
/>

examples.title: Three up
examples.usage: slidesPerView 3 shows three slides; next pages one at a time and stops when the last slide is in view.

examples.title: Loop
examples.usage: Next on the last slide goes back to the first. The buttons stay on.

examples.title: Vertical
examples.usage: A 200-tall track paged up and down, with the buttons above and below.
